milestones.label: Application deadline for the 2027-28 call (set by each country's Fulbright Commission or U.S. Embassy; most have already passed)
milestones.time_text: Varies by home country; reported 2027-28 deadlines fell between April and June 2026
milestones.source_text: The official Fulbright foreign-student site says each home country runs its own selection and deadline, so there is no single global date. Country pages report: Fulbright Philippines (official commission) took applications until 30 April 2026; the American Councils office in Kosovo (official partner of the U.S. Embassy) closed its master's competition on 30 June 2026; a South African university page (unofficial relay) lists 8 April 2026. No 2028-29 opening has been announced yet.
